content.en: Oh! It’s you! How’s the festival been? Having fun?
content.zh: 哎呀！是你啊！在大会上玩得怎么样？开心吗？

content.en: Hello! Thank you again for telling me so much about puppets last night.
content.zh: 您好！昨晚谢谢您告诉我那么多关于木偶的事。

content.en: Hahahaha! Don’t mention it! Not many young people like you are into puppets these days.
content.zh: 哈哈哈哈！别客气！像你这么喜欢木偶的年轻人现在可不多见。

content.en: (Honestly, I only asked because I wanted to break the puppets… I feel a little guilty.)
content.zh: （其实我是为了破坏戏偶才问的......总感觉有点愧疚。）
